info.title: Sub50 agent API
info.description:
Endpoints an external agent needs to run strategic experiments on Sub50, a simulator of
blackouts in the Chilean national grid (SEN). Public base URL: `https://sub50.cl`.

**Ids.** The network has buses `B###` and lines `R###` (`GET /api/v1/sim/network`). Event targets
also accept an area (`A06`), a zone (`NG`), a corridor (`A06-A07/500`), a defence function
(`pdce_zn`) or a real substation id (`SE...`). Event types, policies, objectives and templates come
from `GET /api/v1/sim/catalog`. A run is identified by the `run_id` returned on creation.

**Runs.** Runs in `global-runs` work on the default dataset. Every run is persisted for 24 hours
after its last command and rebuilt from its recipe when the server no longer holds it. Session
endpoints (tags `sessions`, `session-network`, `session-sandbox`, `session-runs`) carry the
session id in the path and work on that session's private copy of the dataset; create a session
first and pass its id to every session call.

**One request at a time.** A session serves one request at a time in a backend process (the SSE
stream excepted); a request waits up to 10 s for the one before it and then gets 409 with
`Retry-After: 1`; retry it. When 10 requests already wait on the session, the 409 comes at once.

**Notice.** Every scenario is hypothetical and simulated: Sub50 models the consequence of an
event on the grid, never the attack technique. The catalog and every run summary carry a
`notice` field saying so.

Errors return `{"detail": ...}`; messages inside `detail` are in Spanish.

post.summary: Simulate failures on the default grid, optionally prepared
post.description: Runs the cascade of the failures (at least one line or substation out) on the grid prepared with `changes`. Returns the timeline, the direct loss and `supply`: per generating substation (by id) and per zone, the people it should feed before the failure against the people it still feeds.

200.description: The cascade of the failures on the prepared grid.

404.description: Unknown point, bus, line, comuna or zone.

422.description: Invalid change or over the overlay limits.

post.summary: Prepare a scenario: population, demand, generation and lines by filters
post.description: Resolves the filters and returns the prepared grid with no failure: what each change touches, lines already over their limit, and the people each generator should feed. It does not simulate. Send the same `changes` with /grids/simulate, /grids/dependency or /grids/cost to run a failure on it.

200.description: The prepared grid with no failure.

404.description: Unknown point, bus, line, comuna or zone.

422.description: Invalid change or over the overlay limits.

get.summary: Find the substation a place resolves to
get.description: Resolves a place as a person names it (a substation, a comuna, a province or region, an area, or an id B###/A##) to one substation of the 188-bus network, with how it was resolved: a comuna goes to the substation that serves most of its people. The same rule as `places` in a change of /grids/prepare. Call it before adding a load or a generator to a session, so the element lands where the person meant.

Call it before creating a run or injecting an event to pick valid targets. Read only.

get.description: Returns every choice an agent can make: `events` (type ids for `inject_run_event` and the target kinds they accept), defensive `actions`, `policies` A/B/C, adversary `objectives`, missions and experiment `templates`. Call it once before creating runs. Read only.

post.summary: Create a strategic run over the default dataset
post.description: Creates a run of the strategic theatre from a template (`GET /api/v1/sim/catalog` → `templates`) with a policy, an optional adversary, uncertainty, seed and initial events. Returns the run summary with its `run_id`, used by every other run call. With `auto_run` the run is played to the end before returning. The run is persisted for 24 hours after its last command and rebuilt from its recipe when the server no longer holds it.

post.summary: Create a shared session
post.description: Creates a session: an editable copy of the 188-bus network pinned to one operating point (default nov2026-1300). Call it first; every other session call takes the returned session_id in the path. The session expires 24 h after its last change. Anyone with the id can read and edit it (share_path is the browser link). Rate limited per client IP.

post.summary: Drop every network edit of a session
post.description: Replaces the overlay with an empty one, so the network is the base dataset again. With a body {scenario: {point?, changes, open_lines, out_buses}} the network becomes that grid configuration instead (changes as overrides, failed buses out of service, open lines cut); a scenario of another point is 422. Runs keep the dataset they were created with; without a scenario the sandbox cut keeps the lines that still exist. Bumps revision and dataset_revision; the ETag is the dataset_revision.
